audit.whatIsWrong: Same chart corruption as the Illaoi page. packet.levelChart = [Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Irelia, Irelia]. content win[] and full phases[].side both read [Darius, Darius, Skill, Darius, Skill, Darius, Darius] — four rows wrong, and the last two are inverted outright.
audit.why: Every other text field on the page states the packet shape. whys[2] 'E-pull plus W slow beat her weak early trading at 3' (row says Skill). whys[4] 'R executes her at 6 before her first damage item lands' (row says Skill). whys[5] 'Her first item flips it — W and Q resets out-fight your all-in' and whys[6] 'Full-build resets and R disarm keep her ahead at 2+ items' — both rows said Darius. The prose agrees again: early 'Levels 1-5 are firmly yours', mid 'Through level 6 you still hold', late 'After her first item this becomes her lane', spikes[2] 'This flips to Irelia', spikes[3] 'Irelia stays ahead'. Six independent statements against four chart cells.
audit.corrected: Chart set to packet shape on both layers: Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Irelia / Irelia. phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten because both argued Darius on rows that now read Irelia. All flips proposed as one group. Ratings deliberately NOT touched — see questionsForUser, the polarity is ambiguous.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text and content.late both claim Irelia's passive gives her 'lifesteal and shred' / 'passive lifesteal/shred'. Ionian Fervor's actual text: 'When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.' No lifesteal. No armour shred. breakdown.early repeats it as 'passive shred'.
audit.why: Three fields invent two effects the champion does not have, and they misdirect the reader about where her sustain comes from — it is Bladesurge, which heals, not the passive. That matters because Bladesurge is the thing Grievous Wounds actually cuts, and a player told 'passive lifesteal' has no idea what to itemise against. Real spike shape: Darius levels 1-5 and the level-6 execute; Irelia at first item and again at full build.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Ionian Fervor correctly (Attack Speed stacks, on-hit damage at max), states explicitly that it gives no lifesteal, points the healing at Bladesurge, and adds the Grievous Wounds timing. content.late and breakdown.early rewritten to drop the invented effects.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive kit interactions in this matchup are both absent. (1) Defiant Dance (W) 'takes reduced physical damage during the charge' — Darius's Q, W, autos and Hemorrhage bleed are all physical, so her W blunts his entire kit EXCEPT Noxian Guillotine, which deals true damage. Nothing on the page connects these. (2) Bladesurge (Q) 'If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes' — and both Flawless Duet (E) and Vanguard's Edge (R) Mark their targets. So her E stun does not merely stun: it converts YOU into a permanent Bladesurge reset. The page treats the E as 'her CC' and never mentions Marks at all.
audit.why: Interaction (1) is the single most useful thing a Darius can know here: her best defensive cooldown is worthless against his ultimate, so the answer to a charging Defiant Dance is R, not disengage. Interaction (2) explains why getting stunned is fatal rather than merely bad — she does not have to break off, she resets onto you. Both are stated plainly in Riot's own text and neither reached a single writable field. Also corrected: spikes[1] calls Flawless Duet a 'root' ('the two-blade root', 'if you get rooted'), and content.mid repeats 'get rooted'. Riot's text says 'damaged, stunned and Marked' — it is a stun.
audit.corrected: True-damage-vs-Defiant-Dance written into tldr, report[0].t, phases[4].why, spikes[1].text, content.mid and report[5].t. The Mark-refreshes-Bladesurge chain written into tldr, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d, spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, content.mid and content.late. 'Root' corrected to 'stun' in spikes[1] and content.mid. Real cooldowns throughout: Flawless Duet 16s rank 1 / 10s rank 5, Defiant Dance 20s rank 1, Bladesurge 6-10s, Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85, Apprehend 26s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood and dosFull[1].d carry the identical templated string with the wrong pronoun ('Pull Irelia as he steps to last-hit'). dosFull[1] is titled 'Dodge her E stun' but its body is that pull line — the body does not describe the mistake the title names.
audit.why: A trade rule against Irelia has to end before she Marks you, because the Mark is what turns a won trade into a chased one. Naming that gives the same-length line an exit condition.
audit.corrected: tradeGood rewritten with the correct pronoun and 'leave before her E Marks you'. dosFull[1].d replaced with an actual Flawless Duet body: two converging blades, only stunned between them, and the Mark consequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no Irelia numbers, duplicated the Apprehend/Ghost paragraph verbatim from breakdown.wave, and terminated in scraped junk: '• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 88'. The same artifact appears mid-sentence inside breakdown.trading as 'Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 89'.
audit.why: Bladesurge is the trap in this field: its printed cooldown is 6-10s, but it refreshes off Marks and off any kill, so quoting the number alone is misleading. The field now says it is never truly down and points the reader at Flawless Duet's 16s/10s as the real timer.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Flawless Duet 16s/10s, Defiant Dance 20s and its physical-only reduction, Bladesurge 6-10s flagged as refreshing, Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85 and its wall, Apprehend 26s. Scraped footer removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page contradicts itself on wave state. spikes[0].text says 'Deny her Q resets by keeping the wave thick and unbroken', while breakdown.early says 'Keep the wave thin'.
audit.why: The mechanic settles it. Bladesurge refreshes when its target is Marked or DIES to it, so what feeds her is an executable low-health minion, not wave size. A thick healthy wave denies resets; a thin wave of chipped minions is a row of free dashes. spikes[0] is right and breakdown.early is wrong.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early rewritten to 'keep the wave healthy — she needs a minion she can execute', aligning it with spikes[0]. dontsFull[0].d rewritten the same way rather than the wave-size framing its title implies.

audit.why: Ganking on Flawless Duet's cooldown is the right trigger — with E spent she has Bladesurge's 600-range dash and nothing else, and no Mark to reset it on.
Conqueror plus Second Wind / Bone Plating is coherent against Irelia's repeated on-hit pattern. Nothing verifiable from the kits to change.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere, despite Bladesurge explicitly healing her and refreshing off Marks and kills.
audit.why: This is the flagged needs-antiheal interaction and it is unusually strong here — a heal on a 6-second cooldown that refreshes is closer to sustained lifesteal than a burst heal, and it is what beats Hemorrhage in an extended fight. I named the effect and the timing but not a specific Grievous Wounds item, since which item Darius should buy is not verifiable from the kits.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now instructs buying Grievous Wounds at first item and explains that a refreshing 6-second Q heals through the bleed all fight.

audit.why: winCon 'Deny resets, dodge E, execute on cooldown' is exactly right; the edits supply the mechanics underneath each clause.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the six Do/Don't bodies do not match their own titles. dosFull[0] 'Deny her Q reset targets' had a body about her CC. dosFull[1] 'Dodge her E stun' had the pull line. dontsFull[0] 'Fight in a big wave' had filler with a wrong pronoun. dontsFull[1] 'Get E-stunned' had a body about burning Apprehend. dontsFull[2] 'Extend into her R + passive' had the whiffed-Apprehend line duplicated from tradeBad.
audit.why: Every one of those titles names a real mechanic that the kit can explain, and every body was filled with unrelated template text. This is the same defect pattern as the Illaoi page, so it is likely generator-wide rather than specific to this matchup.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now explains Bladesurge refreshing off kills. dosFull[1].d explains the converging-blade stun and its Mark. dontsFull[0].d explains executable minions. dontsFull[1].d explains the Mark chaining her dashes onto you. dontsFull[2].d explains Vanguard's Edge's Mark and slowing wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two derived-flag problems. (a) Flawless Duet carries 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes'; Riot's text says only 'damaged, stunned and Marked' — no grounding status. (b) spikes[3].text and content.late describe 'R Vanguard's Edge disarm', but Riot's text for Vanguard's Edge describes damage, a Mark, and a wall that damages and slows — no disarm appears anywhere in the kit file.
audit.why: On (a) I asserted neither the flag nor its negation; the stun alone carries the advice. On (b) I did not assert that the disarm is absent either — the kit text is not exhaustive and 'not in the file' means unknown, not false. I replaced the unverifiable clause with the wall and Mark mechanics that ARE in the text, which are more actionable for Darius anyway since the wall is what stops a Ghost run-down. The disarm question is recorded in unverified.
audit.corrected: No text asserts grounding on Flawless Duet. 'Disarm' removed from spikes[3].text and content.late and replaced with the verified Mark + slowing-wall behaviour.

notes:
REPO-WIDE PATTERN, not matchup-specific — the same three defects hit Illaoi and Irelia identically and are almost certainly on many more Darius pages:
(1) content win[] and full phases[].side disagree with packet.levelChart while every prose field on the page agrees WITH the packet. Illaoi had 6 wrong cells, Irelia 4.
(2) Do/Don't bodies filled with template text unrelated to their titles (5 of 6 wrong here, 3 of 6 on Illaoi), and the same three template strings reused: the 'Pull <enemy> as he steps to last-hit' line, the 'Your committal tool is the lane' line, and the 'Whiffing Apprehend' line.
(3) breakdown.cooldowns ends in a scraped page footer — 'Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 88' here, '73' on Illaoi. The artifact also sits MID-SENTENCE inside breakdown.trading on this page ('...easy execution loop. Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 89 Bad trade:...'). Worth a repo-wide grep for 'Darius Top Lane Matchup Database' — I only cleaned breakdown.cooldowns.

Wrong pronoun ('he'/'his' for a female champion) appears in tradeGood, phases[0].why, breakdown.mid, dontsFull[0].d and report[11].t on both pages. I fixed the first four; report[11].t 'Chase him through the wave for free poke' is left untouched because it is a composite field I had no length-safe rewrite for.

Defiant Dance's physical-only damage reduction against Noxian Guillotine's true damage is the strongest finding on this page and it was absent from all 40+ writable fields. If other Darius matchups face physical-damage-reduction effects, they likely have the same hole.

I did not touch phases[N].rating on this page — the polarity is genuinely ambiguous and I would be guessing. See questionsForUser.
